# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

As the sole maintainer of this project, I take security seriously. Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues. 

To report a security issue, please use the GitHub Security Advisory ["Report a Vulnerability"](https://github.com/rock-stevens/lcm-lora-studio/security/advisories/new) tab.

Please report security bugs in third-party modules to the person or team maintaining the module.


### Please include:
* Description of the issue
* Steps to reproduce
* Potential impact

I will review your report and work on a solution as quickly as possible. Thank you for helping to keep this project secure.
